state.review: Re-evaluate selected choreography rows with the complete row, exact proof contract, selected source/target owner invariants, and full entry/read/abort contracts. A dispatcher or registered reactor is not proof of target commitment. Distinguish genuine missing proof from evidence not applicable to this row kind.

ownerFacts.invariant: One engagement lifecycle, proposed and actual staff assignments, current content revision and accepted epoch bindings. Engagement revision and service epoch live in state; historical epoch streams cannot compete independently.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Never reactivate a permanent independence commitment from reevaluation; acceptance binds exact service, draft, acknowledgement and ratified-rule proofs.

ownerFacts.invariant: Complete immutable nonattest-service history manifest, current service epoch and acceptance admission barrier. A changed service set advances epoch and makes old acceptance ineligible immediately through authoritative composed reads.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Never reactivate a permanent independence commitment from reevaluation; acceptance binds exact service, draft, acknowledgement and ratified-rule proofs.

ownerFacts.invariant: Frozen campaign snapshot, generation, and compact completion gate.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Keep reviewer and remediation owner distinct per item unless exact waiver; no stale projected summary may satisfy completion.

ownerFacts.invariant: One reviewer decision, reassignment, remediation verification, exception and history for one frozen item.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Keep reviewer and remediation owner distinct per item unless exact waiver; no stale projected summary may satisfy completion.

ownerFacts.invariant: One provider content, version and retirement lifecycle.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Exact creation identity and expected provider revision; active normalized name unique within tenant.

ownerFacts.invariant: Authoritative unique active name reservation.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Exact creation identity and expected provider revision; active normalized name unique within tenant.

ownerFacts.invariant: Independent location record lifecycle.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Kind is immutable; only active same-kind names are unique.

ownerFacts.invariant: Authoritative active-name uniqueness claim.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Kind is immutable; only active same-kind names are unique.

ownerFacts.identity: Tenant singleton manager guard in its existing address. Selected CommandId binds exact contributor/member episode, generation and withdrawal/restoration transition; current complete eligible contributors remain authoritative.
ownerFacts.invariant: Removal from effective administrator set must leave another active tenant administrator.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Without a shared authoritative decision/hold two removals could each rely on the other. The coordination boundary is justified; guard-to-member transition protocol is incomplete.

ownerFacts.identity: Existing UUIDv5 of TenantId + UserId; membership episodes remain distinct and exact. Selected CommandId binds the original member/episode and intended transition.
ownerFacts.invariant: One tenant-user membership has one affiliation/expiry episode; deprovision closes authority and a fresh episode cannot start until authority cleanup completes.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Affiliation, lifecycle and current episode must change together. Cleanup completion is an authority-release gate; membership roster/grants remain external.

ownerFacts.identity: Existing UUIDv5 of the normalized email address. ChallengeId and selected CommandId are distinct stable operation identities bound to this exact address, owner and recovery episode.
ownerFacts.invariant: A normalized address reserves exactly one platform user; verification requires its current challenge; a claimed recovery binds one old/replacement pair.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Ownership and current-proof consumption require one authority; delivery outcomes do not. A recovery lifecycle can be separate only with durable claim/admission and revocation recovery.

ownerFacts.invariant: Immutable both-proof-verified candidate and preparation; complete protection proofs precede accepted exact swap. Preparation can reject/fence; accepted swap completes forward. Exact account, old/replacement identities and actor/proof provenance retained without bearer tokens.
Immutable policy/material version and frozen audience plus closure generation.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Every result binds the accepted campaign version/hash and included participant; after close, no result accepted.

ownerFacts.invariant: Independent acknowledgement, completion, exception and delivery status.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Every result binds the accepted campaign version/hash and included participant; after close, no result accepted.

ownerFacts.invariant: Manifest identity, selected immutable content version and delivery gate.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: No current aggregate should retain all build attempts or delivery history as command state.

ownerFacts.invariant: One delivery authorization and terminal delivery for exact recipient/version.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: No current aggregate should retain all build attempts or delivery history as command state.

ownerFacts.invariant: One active signed duty designation and monotonic signed authority revision per exact subject/duty/scope; retain continuity proof. The platform scope is explicit and is not an empty tenant UUID.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Exact predecessor, monotonically increasing authority revision, stable signed subject, valid staff source proof.

ownerFacts.identity: Existing UUIDv5 of tenant + team + member. Each assignment episode remains exact; selected native operation/receiver identity is bound to that member/team episode.
ownerFacts.invariant: One tenant/team/member relationship is active only for one current membership episode.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Membership episode and active flag must be together; team-wide roster does not need an atomic revision. Tenant-manager invariant requires separate authoritative removal coordination.

ownerFacts.identity: Tenant / existing EvidenceStreams artifact key / ArtifactId, with immutable source identity and verified content binding. ArtifactId identifies registration; selected mutations use CommandId. Download grants use the separately adopted artifact-qualified receiving identity.
ownerFacts.invariant: Immutable content remains unavailable until clean inspection; malware alone can be released with attributed clean rescan; secret/invalid rejection is final.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Inspection and quarantine release share availability decision. Download authorization needs an admission proof against that decision but every historical download need not extend artifact lifecycle stream.

ownerFacts.invariant: Small selection, readiness, revocation/closure and admission-generation authority.
ownerFacts.mustPreserve: Feedback records exact selected source version and admitted generation; later selection makes it historical.

ownerFacts.identity: Caller TenantId is immutable tenant creation identity; lifecycle operations use caller CommandId.
ownerFacts.invariant: One tenant lifecycle activates only after its slug and first-administrator conditions; offboarding forbids new active service; one current slug transition admitted at a time.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Tenant lifecycle and activation/current-slug link need coherence; global slug uniqueness belongs slug authority. Previous slug history and transport correlation need not live in tenant.

ownerFacts.identity: Existing UUIDv5 of tenant + team + role. Selected CommandId binds the exact assignment episode and removal intent.
ownerFacts.invariant: One tenant/team/role relationship has a single active assignment.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Each role assignment lifecycle independent; Team need not own collection. Critical built-in role removal policy remains external command admission.

ownerFacts.identity: Existing UUIDv5 of tenant + role + normalized permission. Selected CommandId and assignment episode bind the exact assignment/removal intent.
ownerFacts.invariant: One normalized role-permission tuple has a single active relationship at a time.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Relationship can be assigned/removed without serializing unrelated permissions; a roster in Role is unnecessary.

ownerFacts.identity: UUIDv5 namespace ArtifactId, UTF8 artifact-download-grant:v1:{canonical TenantId}:{canonical CommandId}. Receiving root additionally verifies exact artifact/command/original-actor tuple. No generic operation lookup.
ownerFacts.invariant: One exact receiving grant owns the authenticated encrypted original artifact ticket/result after EvidenceArtifact first admitted and pinned availability with frozen202. Complete required held source uses and exact issue DecisionAt precede native issued-v2; cancellation fences delayed issuance and terminal proofs settle all uses. Original expiry never renews under the same root identity. Existing artifact-issued v1 decoder remains read-only compatibility.

verification.admission: AdmissionReference is a locator only. Resolve and independently verify actual typed admitted fact, exact owner/tenant/program, saved metadata and physical/hydrated cut, original root/episode/actor/intent and immutable content.
verification.stageAndTerminal: Materialize each required typed stage/terminal proof from actual committed facts and full required immutable selections; prove complete grant/fence/provisional/child sets, not counts/checkpoints. Guard sets are not weakened by carrier choice.
verification.earlyReplay: If native receipt binding does not cover a supplied/interpreted command term, bind that term through the required actual typed proof/body before early replay. Exact receipt cannot bypass proof manifest or source tuple guards.
verification.resultAndRecovery: Current public authorization precedes replay. Original result/receipt and unknown-append recovery stay exact; requested cancellation propagates. Unavailable proof/content remains transient; corruption/changed intent is permanent; no inferred absence/release.
verification.implementationStatus: Installed pointer/handler/process presence is not proof of conformance. Field/wire migration and required behavioral tests remain separately verifiable implementation work.

requiredProofContract.pinnedSourceRequirements: Every exact source owner/event/content revision and complete immutable manifest required by intendedProofGate remains mandatory; no absent optional source is fabricated.
requiredProofContract.proofGate: Use existing normalization/active/kind policy; new and old claims acquired canonically. Permanent unique active binding until exact record change/fence.
requiredProofContract.requiredLogicalPrerequisiteProofs: Every applicable logical prerequisite is independently verified as an actual typed saved fact (or actual technical proof where explicitly technical); a terminal proof may establish an earlier stage only through a verified native chain that includes that required typed stage. Stage order/checkpoint alone never substitutes.

effectIdentity.implementationQualification: Selected policy only; individual new algorithm/wire implementation must prove exact vectors and domain/compatibility fences before emission.
